name: LA-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: District's R+20 partisan lean anchors the seat firmly in Republican territory
Scalise's overwhelming financial edge: $10.6M raised and $3.9M on hand versus $143K for the Democrat
No public polls or expert ratings show competitiveness; prediction markets price Republicans near 96%
Scalise's seniority in House GOP leadership gives him high name recognition in a low-attention race
model.rationale: The district's twenty-point Republican lean, Scalise's long incumbency and leadership profile, and a lopsided fundraising advantage leave no sign of a competitive race; prediction markets price Republicans near ninety-six percent and no polling or ratings point the other way.
model.watch: Only a severe national backlash or unexpected scandal could tighten the margin, and even then a Democratic win would require an unprecedented swing in this district.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Louisiana's 1st District, anchored in the New Orleans suburbs and surrounding parishes, leans Republican by roughly twenty points, and Steve Scalise has held the seat since 2008 while rising through House Republican leadership. He enters the general election with a vast financial edge, having raised more than ten million dollars and holding nearly four million on hand, while Democrat Lauren Jewett has raised about one hundred forty thousand with little cash remaining. An independent and a second Republican also appear on the ballot, though Louisiana's majority-vote system shapes how the race resolves.

No public polls or expert ratings track the contest, and prediction markets put Republican chances near ninety-six percent. With the incumbent's profile, the district's partisan lean, and the spending gap all pointing the same direction, the seat sits firmly in Safe Republican territory, with any Democratic upside dependent on a dramatic shift in the national environment.
